claims: Tonga is officially the Kingdom of Tonga.
Tonga is a Polynesian sovereign state.
Tonga is an archipelago in the South Pacific Ocean.
Tonga is known as the "Friendly Islands".
Most of Tonga's islands are uninhabited.
Tonga is located near Fiji and Samoa.
Tonga has a population of roughly 100,000.
Tonga is located along the Tonga-Kermadec subduction zone.
Tonga's islands are divided into volcanic and limestone areas.
Tonga is the only hereditary constitutional monarchy in Oceania.
Tonga never formally lost its sovereignty.
Tonga was a British protected state from 1900 to 1970.
Tongan culture includes the use of ngatu (bark cloth).
A 7.5 to 7.6 magnitude earthquake occurred near Tonga's islands on March 24, 2026.
No major damage was reported from the earthquake on March 24, 2026.
